FAN_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.createFanUpload: Receive fan media, validate, save to FAN_UPLOADS
FAN_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.getFanUpload: Return single fan upload by ID
FAN_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.getPendingFanUploads: Return all pending fan uploads for admin review
FAN_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.approveFanUpload: Admin approves fan upload and updates status
FAN_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.rejectFanUpload: Admin rejects fan upload and updates status
FAN_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.deleteFanUpload: Admin or Super Admin deletes fan upload

LEADERS_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.createLeaderUpload: Admin/Super Admin uploads media to LEADERS_UPLOADS
LEADERS_UPLOADS_CONTROLLER.getLeaderUpload: Return single leader upload by ID

PRODUCTS_MEDIA_CONTROLLER.createProductMedia: Upload product media and save to PRODUCTS_MEDIA
PRODUCTS_MEDIA_CONTROLLER.getProductMedia: Return single product media by ID

BANNERS_CONTROLLER.createBanner: Upload banner and save to BANNERS_LIBRARY

EVENTS_MEDIA_CONTROLLER.createEventMedia: Upload event media and save to EVENTS_MEDIA
EVENTS_MEDIA_CONTROLLER.getEventMedia: Return single event media by ID

SYSTEM_CONTROLLER.getLogs: Super Admin only — return system logs
